repair: On changed authority, perform an exact-key registry lookup before constructing the one-node authoritative sampler; construct/bind the sampler only after a genuine registry miss.
finding: Sampler construction was a real avoidable component of warm changed-authority binding. Deferring it until a true registry miss removes about one fifth of the measured changed-authority warm-hit cost without changing table ownership, key authority, representation or fallback semantics.
next_action: Re-characterize 16/64-key switching on the repaired path. Only pursue immutable-table ownership/handle changes if a material switching gap remains.
nonclaims: This is a bind-level microbenchmark, not an application speed claim.
No table pointer or registry ownership semantics were changed.
